args.message:
Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212

The nightly build failed because tests/test_money.py expects banker's
rounding, but round_money was rounding with ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch to
ROUND_HALF_EVEN as documented in the docstring and required by FIN-212.

args.head: fix/fin-212-round-half-even
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build was failing because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py:round_money` was implementing `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

- Changed `round_money` in `src/money.py` to quantize with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP` (the docstring already claimed banker's rounding; the implementation now matches).

## Verification

- Opened branch `fix/fin-212-round-half-even`, committed the fix, and ran CI (run `ci-0001`, sha `08d3cd5986`): **passed**, including `tests/test_money.py`, which asserts:
  - `round_money(Decimal("2.675")) == Decimal("2.68")`
  - `round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")`

References: FIN-212
